summary: The idle daemon budget test seeds its graph without waiting on an fsync for each of its 1,450 commits, then restores the store's own setting before the daemon starts; it takes about 49 s instead of 66 s and measures the same window.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to seed with an fsync per commit again.
